description: **New: the `hygiene` package.** One `hygiene.Isolate(t)` call gives a Go test a throwaway `HOME`, an empty git config with a throwaway identity, `GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL=file`, and an environment stripped of every ambient credential -- all restored when the test ends. Granular helpers (`ThrowawayHome`, `IsolateGitConfig`, `LockdownTransports`, `StripCredentials`, `Chdir`) and a closed `Preserve` enum for toolchain caches ship alongside it.
